title: Ever notice how you grind harder when you’re 90% to the next level in...
description: Ever notice how you grind harder when you’re 90% to the next level in a game? That’s not willpower. That’s psychology. It’s called the goal gradient effect. The closer we feel to a win, the faster we move. That’s why games show progress bars and XP meters. And it’s why smart marketing does the same. Show people progress, and they don’t quit.
transcript: It's all about perception. Have you ever played a video game where you grind harder when you're close to leveling up? You know, when you're at like 90% XP, suddenly you can't stop playing. That is the goal gradient effect in action. We as humans naturally accelerate when we can see how close we are to the next level. Video game designers have known this for decades, and that's why they show you progress bars and XP counters and achievement percentages.
